text: and finally, first thing that whole doc needs to address before anything else is done: delete all the floating loose labs and the direct hmsc/ directory. its all junk / old, as far as im concerned, we have ported in the capability from them, now its just causing trauma, i saw a claude making edits in the wrong space today, not again
resolution: Wrote §0 of the structure review (commit 2e2f7841f) — THE DEMOLITION ORDER, placed ahead of every other finding per the user's ruling: delete all floating loose lab carts + the hmsc/ directory (hmsc/ verified already gone at 77726e201). Enumerated the exact kill list from docs/game/*.md per req_0611's clarification (30 carts, every path verified on disk), separated the meta docs that stay, and found TWO load-bearing blockers that must be captured BEFORE rm or the surviving tool breaks: cart/cutout/ (~20 live imports from editors/workbench paint/characters/items/vehicles/materials — the CUTOUTFLIP capture killed the route but left the implementation in the old cart) and cart/animationDsl.ts (compile/playerModel.ts imports the parser/sampler; capture into game/animation per V6). Flagged hmsc-int-old/, scape3d/, heads/, deadcode/ as adjacent junk needing one user word. Wrote the execution order: coordinate parallel lanes → two captures → git rm by explicit path → retire the per-cart .md + _index records in the same commit → ship + bake verify.
